purpose: New-subject expansion corpus for external evaluation and confirmation of the frozen TENGOD and SHINSAL_ALL Career ranking candidates selected on SAJU_ML_CORPUS_V1.
core_rule: Y is real-world life events only; astrology/model outputs are forbidden from labels.

split_policy.NEW_DEV: 70 subjects. May be used to evaluate the already-frozen candidate families and select a single winner. No new feature-family/hyperparameter search.
split_policy.NEW_CONFIRM: 30 fresh subjects. One-shot confirmation only after a winner/freeze manifest is written from NEW_DEV. Must not be used for candidate selection or debugging.
split_policy.assignment: 57 previously unused Rodden-AA public candidates were placed in NEW_DEV. 43 completely fresh AA-birth subjects were selected before scoring; 13 assigned NEW_DEV and 30 assigned NEW_CONFIRM.

career_label_policy.minimum_per_subject: at least 2 positive Career years and at least 1 negative Career year
career_label_policy.preferred_confirmation: 2 positive + 2 negative Career years where a clean second negative is available
career_label_policy.same_year_conflict: positive and negative Career labels in the same subject-year are forbidden for V2
career_label_policy.unknown_rule: absence of evidence is unknown, never negative/neutral

birth_policy.required: exact birth time for every subject
birth_policy.primary_source: VedAstro 15,000 Famous People Birth Date & Location dataset
birth_policy.engine_adapter: public_runtime_longitude_correction using date/time/utc_offset/longitude, matching the Public DEV path used in ML V1

event_source_policy.current_level: public biography curation, mostly single-source URLs
event_source_policy.qa_warning: This is a research expansion corpus, not a publication-grade historical dataset. Second-source audit is recommended, especially before interpreting NEW_CONFIRM as a definitive scientific holdout.
